summary: Iter 164 — Home Sections layout (order + visibility) end-to-end PASS. Backend (7/7 pytest) + Admin UI + Rider /home reflection all confirmed. Reorder (beauty above delivery) persists across reload and is reflected on rider /home; hiding 'À proximité' removes it from /home and the public section_order; toggling back restores it. Taxi 8-tile canonical section unaffected (service_categories driven). No runtime errors. Final state RESTORED to default order with nearby visible=true.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/home_categories.py: HOME_BLOCKS (19) seeded idempotently into home_sections collection on startup; _section_layout() backfills any future blocks at the end with display_order=1000+i so newly added blocks never silently disappear — good defensive design.
Admin endpoints correctly gated by require_permission('content.manage'); unauthenticated GET /admin/sections returns 401/403 as expected.
POST /admin/sections/{key}/toggle simply flips the boolean — verified twice (off then on) and idempotent.
POST /admin/sections/reorder sets display_order by index over ordered_keys; verified beauty<delivery after reorder, and restore returns delivery<beauty.
Public GET /api/home-categories returns section_order filtered by visible=true (hidden keys correctly drop out). Verified by hiding nearby and seeing it disappear from section_order.

AdminHomeCategories.js section-layout-panel exposes 19 rows with section-up-<key>, section-down-<key>, section-toggle-<key> testids — moveSection writes ordered keys back via reorderSections and the order persists across page reload.

UserHome.js correctly drives section render order from fetched section_order (with DEFAULT_SECTION_ORDER fallback) — confirmed by checking that 'Beauté' appeared before 'Livraison' on rider /home when admin moved beauty up.
Toggle 404 verified for unknown key (good error handling).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin section-layout-panel, reorder persistence across reload, toggle hide/show with toasts 'Section masquée'/'Section affichée', rider /home reflection of order + hide, taxi 8-tile regression, no runtime overlay)
